about: Package 3b's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/31-cartridges.mjs), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison; a count that changes fails it too.

accepted.why: Deviation 11 (slice-accepted.json): every button and input carries its type.
Deviations 6 and 10: a segmented choice is a named group (role, name, aria-label: 22 each), and a choice's data-v is its value, not its words (56).
Deviation 10: the concept's delegation hooks on Quick's choice rows (data-setq, data-setn, data-base) and on Stack them (data-setv) are absent; the rebuild's buttons run their own actions.

Package 1's choice row says what each choice sets as the page writes the value ("Slot 1: 0.50", "Temperature: 0.40"); the concept printed the bare number (controls-accepted.json counts the same kind).
Standards mode (slice-accepted.json): the LCD picker's arrows on the Rebase on picker take no line height; drawn in the same place.
The pad and How adventurous stand back by their own mark (data-dim, styles/rebuild/25-planner.css) where the concept fades them from the tile's lm-off class: the same opacity, the same words.
The Plan fader carries its parameter's tip on its slot (package 2's containers-accepted.json counts the same); the concept says it on the bank's heading only, as the rebuild's heading does too.
The planner's pad keeps the XY pad's own how-to as its tip; the concept's planner empties it after painting (25-module-planner.js), for no reason it states.
A rebase row always carries a tip, empty while it has none (the concept's ACE-Step row does so; its YuE2 row has none).

The adapter list opens below its button where the concept's opened above it (the desk's layout puts the tile a few pixels higher here); placed by the same rule, its arrival animation follows the side.
